items.title: InvIT IPO rush gathers pace, 4-5 trusts likely to go public by Mar 2027
items.description:
Four to five privately placed Infrastructure Investment Trusts (InvITs) are expected to tap the public markets by March 2027 to raise a combined Rs 17,000 crore, as infrastructure developers increasingly turn to this route to mobilise long-term capital and monetise operational assets, investment bankers said.
InvITs have already mobilised around Rs 88,000 crore through equity issuances during FY23-FY25, indicating growing investor appetite for infrastructure-backed investment opportunities, according to the Bharat InvITs Association.
Among the proposed public offerings, Brookfield-backed Altius Telecom Infrastructure Trust has filed for a potential Rs 6,000-crore IPO as it seeks to convert from a privately placed to a publicly offered InvIT.
Investcorp-backed NDR InvIT Trust is also planning to transition into a public InvIT through an issue of up to Rs 750 crore, while KKR and Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan (OTPP)-sponsored Vertis Infrastructure Trust is also exploring an IPO.

items.title: Mahindra Last Mile Mobility eyes IPO in 18 months to fund next growth phase
items.description:
Mahindra Last Mile Mobility Ltd (MLMML) is looking at a public listing in about 18 months to unlock value and fund its next phase of growth, including expansion into new product segments and capacity augmentation, even as it explores potential opportunities in overseas markets, according to the company's Chairman Rajesh Jejurikar.
In an interview to PTI, Jejurikar, also the Executive Director and CEO of Mahindra & Mahindra's Auto and Farm Sectors, said Mahindra Last Mile Mobility, which already has a valuation of around USD 1 billion, has two investors on board, with a third expected to come in shortly.
He, however, clarified that the 18-month timeline is broad and the company has not finalised a listing date, as it does not want the management to get distracted by the process and effort involved in an initial public offering (IPO).
